entities.name: Prismatic Piper
entities.description: Theorized shapeshifting spirit of pure mana existing across all planes, heard as a flute by mages in need.

events.summary: Mages in great need cast unfamiliar spells, reporting a hauntingly beautiful flute in their heads.
events.quote: it was as if their head was filled with music, that of a hauntingly beautiful flute.
